summary: Iteration 5 — Festive Box Editor + new pink-gift-box imagery. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (added 4 new tests: new photo IDs in image URLs across all 5 boxes, GET /api/festive-boxes/eid-box hydrated correctly with total 3200, GET /api/festive-boxes/unknown-box → 404, and end-to-end order from editor uses FULL prices — coconut-loaf 1200, lotus-cookie 300, papparoti-batch 800 → subtotal 3200 + pink-ribbon 150 = 3350). All prior regression tests still pass (products/packaging/festive totals/match/orders happy path + all error paths). Frontend: All 5 home cards expose data-testid festive-customize-<box_id> and Link navigates to /festive/<id>. FestiveBoxEditor loads eid-box with seed items (coconut-loaf qty 1, lotus-cookie qty 4, papparoti-batch qty 1), festive-items-total=Rs. 3,200 and festive-total=Rs. 3,350 with default pink-ribbon. +coconut → items-total=Rs. 4,400. remove coconut → item disappears and items-total=Rs. 2,000. add-more-toggle opens panel; loaf tab renders loaf cards; +lemon-loaf inserts festive-in-lemon-loaf and items-total=Rs. 2,850. Pack white-ribbon updates festive-preview-ribbon class to preview-ribbon-white and total=Rs. 3,000. Personal note reflected in festive-preview-tag. Editor checkout: navigates to /checkout with cart populated (summary-subtotal=Rs. 3,200), form submission creates order TT956879 with total Rs. 3,350 (subtotal 3,200 + pink ribbon 150) using full prices — end-to-end verified.

integration_issues.issue: Checkout page briefly shows summary-total equal to subtotal (packaging line missing) until GET /api/packaging resolves. Once loaded, the pink-ribbon Rs. 150 line and total Rs. 3,350 render correctly and the placed order is correct. Minor UX flicker — consider gating summary render on packagings.length>0 or persisting the price in CartContext.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py new endpoint GET /api/festive-boxes/{box_id} correctly returns 404 for unknowns and reuses _hydrate_box for consistency with the list endpoint.
FestiveBoxEditor.jsx uses local RIBBONS constant duplicating /api/packaging. Prices/IDs match today but drift risk exists — consider fetching /api/packaging like Checkout does.

FestiveBoxEditor.jsx: `box === false` branch is unreachable (setBox is only ever called with data or null in catch). Loading and error states are handled via `box === null`; if the box_id is invalid the page will remain in 'Loading…' forever. Recommend explicit error state (e.g., setBox({error:true})).
FestiveBoxEditor.jsx: addToCart always passes custom_box:false → order line items use full prices (correct per iteration spec).

FestiveBoxEditor.jsx: If a user adds a custom-box-eligible product (e.g., brownies-batch) via the add-more panel, it will be checked out at the FULL batch price (Rs. 1,000), which is by design here but differs from the /build page semantics — worth calling out in copy to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: One order TT956879 created in db.orders (TEST Buyer, subtotal 3200 + pink-ribbon 150 = 3350). Consider clearing db.orders on next reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_public_api.py now covers 15 tests. Iteration 5 additions: test_festive_boxes_new_image_urls (each of 5 image URLs contains one of the 4 new Unsplash photo IDs), test_get_festive_box_eid_hydrated (eid-box total=3200 with correct items+qty), test_get_festive_box_unknown_404, test_order_from_festive_editor_uses_full_prices (custom_box=False, subtotal=3200+pack=150=3350). Frontend Playwright verified all festive-customize-<box_id> links, editor seed items, add/remove/plus/minus, add-more panel (tabs+add-plus), ribbon swaps preview-ribbon class, personal note reflects in preview-tag, and end-to-end order placement from editor. Minor flicker on Checkout summary-total on first render while /api/packaging loads — order backend result is unaffected.
